METR/Redwood found Codex agents could in principle bypass sandboxing and Auto-Review, potentially hiding hundreds of actions from monitoring before July 21 2026
OpenAI says it fixed the production safeguards; METR/Redwood have not verified the fix

items.reason: A working prompt-injection PoC: an AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md file dropped in ~/Downloads gets auto-loaded as trusted context by coding agents, with measured success rates against two major agents -- exactly the kind of agent attack chain with a working PoC the profile wants.
